Powered Suit Irradiators
This heavy biped utilizes specialized, large-caliber darts to turn Bugs against their own kind or seize direct control over individual specimens.

Two types of projectiles are available:
• The default 'Pheromone Disruption' dart delivers a nerve agent that enrages the target, driving it to attack any unaffected Arachnids in the vicinity
• The 'Mind Control' dart injects a neurochemical interface that grants the Overseer direct control over a single specimen. The biped must remain in close proximity to sustain this neural link.

Note that, due to the large size and mass of these darts, targeting smaller Bug variants will outright crush and kill them.

The Acid Grenadier is a large, well armored Bug type that launches globs of a volatile substance toward their enemies. These projectiles generally transmute into corrosive acid on impact, but curiously, some globs have been found to contain live Buzzer Drones. How this symbiosis between Acid Grenadiers and Buzzers is initiated is currently unknown.
